title: WSDL Interface
description: Schema describing an interface element in a WSDL 2.0 document. An interface defines a set of abstract operations and the abstract messages exchanged by each operation, independent of any particular binding or transport protocol.

name.description: The local name of the interface, unique within the WSDL target namespace.

extends.description: A list of qualified names of interfaces that this interface extends.

styleDefault.description: Default operation style URIs applied to operations within this interface.

fault.description: A list of interface fault declarations.

operation.description: A list of abstract operation definitions within this interface.
